workflow: Document source concept meaning with official source evidence
Submit a MappingReview record with proposed or pending_review status
Qualified reviewer checks source definition, target meaning, instrument and measurement compatibility
Record reviewer, qualification, evidence, date and version for approval or rejection
Keep source benchmark and field predictive validation separate
production_activation: No automatic activation. An approved semantic mapping does not validate a piano model.
review_attestation: Review identity must be verified by the project owner; a JSON field alone is not external expert approval.
